decision_cruda.rationale: LH-04 is repaired in place, likely 09:54 and at worst 10:00. The radio and CMMS agree. A loan would arrive after the repair is done, and the stope has only 238 t left. Central is truck-limited (inflow 118 t/h against 91 t/h truck capacity), so an extra loader adds little. A loan from a development heading would also cost 1.9 to 4.0 oz per hour. Best action: no loans.

LH-04 is down until about 14:30-17:30 (likely 15:30). Central is already truck-limited: the loaders there feed 118 t/h against 91 t/h of truck capacity, and the stockpile is at 278 of 450 t. Covering C590-05 with another loader would add no hauled ounces. Este is also truck-limited (78 inflow against 72 truck). Norte has truck headroom, but its only loading stope, N548-10, has 189 t, which LH-07 already clears at 29 t/h by 17:00. Taking LH-08 or LH-09 off development would cost 1.9 or 4.0 oz per hour for no gain. LH-10 is still in preventive maintenance until 11:00. No reserve can be activated because no stope is stopped. Best decision is no loans.
